note: 題組正本(roadmap §11/§12)。門檻設在 noul/score 值,不設在 confidence。criteria 寫成可驗證的句子。任何改動都會改變 questionset_hash(見 manifest.py)。

goal_clear.text: Given only the discussion record's Goals and Real-world Context sections, can a reader state the single primary outcome this change must produce without asking the author?

scope_clear.text: Does the discussion record name what is inside and outside this change precisely enough that a Decide-stage writer could list the affected files, interfaces or data without guessing?

acceptance_clear.text: Does the record contain at least one acceptance statement that could be turned into a pass/fail check, or state exactly what the spec stage still has to define?

owner_call_pending.text: Does the record contain a product or value choice that only the project owner may decide and that has not yet been decided in the record?

ambiguity.text: How much executable ambiguity remains in the record?

criteria.label: none
criteria.description: Every open question is either answered or marked as an explicit assumption with an owner.

criteria.label: minor
criteria.description: Open items exist but none changes what would be built first.

criteria.label: material
criteria.description: At least one open item changes the scope or the primary outcome.

criteria.label: blocking
criteria.description: The primary outcome or the affected system boundary is undefined.

next.text: Which next step does the record support?

criteria.START_DECIDE: Goals, scope and acceptance are stated well enough to compare solution options.
criteria.ASK_MORE: A specific clarity dimension is missing and can be resolved by asking the requester.
criteria.NEEDS_OWNER_DECISION: Progress depends on a value or product choice that only the owner may make.

demo_worth_it.text: Given the spec's Operational Context and the prototype's trigger assessment, would a human operating the demo be likely to change at least one requirement or scenario?

g3_route.text: Given the mechanical header facts and the reviewer evidence summary, which G3 handling does the evidence support?

criteria.AUTO_SHIP: Every required layer passed in the Final Fresh Run bound to the current HEAD, the gauntlet passed, e2e ran, and no reviewer axis reports an open finding.
criteria.HUMAN_REVIEW: Evidence is present but at least one item needs a human judgement before shipping.
criteria.REQUEST_CHANGES: A required layer failed, a finding is open, or the evidence contradicts itself.

risk.text: What kind of change does the evidence describe?

criteria.label: cosmetic
criteria.description: Only presentation or wording changed; no persisted data, no external call, no permission.

criteria.label: contained
criteria.description: Logic changed but no persisted data, external call, permission or migration is touched.

criteria.label: persisted_or_external
criteria.description: Persisted data, an external call, or a permission rule is touched.

criteria.label: irreversible_or_security
criteria.description: A migration, deletion, security or payment path is touched.

evidence_complete.text: Does the evidence summary cover every layer the spec's Verification Profile requires, with a numeric result for each passed layer?
